title: Scheme-chart face ringed total site of an augmented simplicial algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $Z$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale site, regular-functions sheaf and module category [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $U$ a simplicial object in the slice over $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Restrict $U$ along the injective order maps $\Delta_{\mathrm{inj}}\hookrightarrow\Delta$. Define the scheme-chart face total site as follows. An object is a pair $([n],T\to U_n)$ with $T$ a scheme over $S$ and $T\to U_n$ representable etale. An arrow from $([n],T\to U_n)$ to $([m],V\to U_m)$ is an injection $[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$ and a scheme map $T\to V$ whose square over the corresponding face map $U_n\to U_m$ commutes. The topology is the least Grothendieck topology containing the images of all covering sieves of every small etale fibre. This is the scheme-chart basis presentation of the ringed total site [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category] of the enlarged etale sites [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. Define its ring presheaf by $([n],T)\mapsto\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ and restriction by pullback of regular functions; this presheaf is a sheaf. Write $\mathscr M_U$ for its module sheaves, with rings and section modules in the original scheme universe. Fibre inclusion is continuous and defines component evaluation. For every total module $M$ and every injection $\alpha:[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$, define the unique transition $f_\alpha^*M_m\to M_n$ sending a local tensor $b\otimes s$ on any chart square to $b$ times the total restriction of $s$. Here tensor pullback, its local charts and local tensor sections are those of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], and its composition is normalized as in [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition]. An augmentation presentation consists of additive functors $u^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)\to\mathscr M_U$ and $u_*:\mathscr M_U\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)$, an adjunction $u^*\dashv u_*$, natural component identifications $(u^*G)_n\simeq u_n^*G$, and compatibility with all chart restrictions: transport a section by the inverse component identification, restrict in the total module, and transport by the target component identification; the result must be insertion $s\mapsto1\otimes s$ followed by the specified tensor-composition comparison. Such an augmentation presentation exists for every $U$, with no flatness assumption. The total site has left-exact additive sheafification in that same section universe, inverting exactly the locally bijective maps, and its module category has unbounded K-injective resolutions. Use the original-universe additive sheafification on the base etale site supplied by [def-sfb-space-comm-algebra-sheaf].
